notes: Adoption is a presentation-adapter decision (Codex): the variants are delivered in parallel under ClientGodot/assets/audio/composed/ambience/ and do NOT replace the ported PackV1 files, the v01 masters, or their cue bindings. A runtime adapter may rotate v01/v02/v03 per cue (NO_IMMEDIATE_REPEAT) or keep v01 only.

Variant loudness targets are the same ported cues' checkpoint-07 measured LUFS as v01, so any variant sits at the same mix level the P0 draft mixes were designed around. Loudness/true-peak are measured from real bytes; no ear audition has been done.

Ambience cues loop by construction (1.5 s tail wrap); the seam block records the checkpoint-07 indicator, not a seamlessness PASS. Crowd beds are filtered noise only: no voice, no words, no intelligible speech is possible by construction.

SFX side of M-E: the 173 ported SFX/UI cues already carry 3 measured variants each (checkpoint 08, SFX_UI_pack_v1) so no new SFX variants were composed in this checkpoint; composed SFX replacements remain a separate Codex decision, not silently assumed here.
